card.text: TOI-5624 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-5624 b"
sources.quote: TOI-5624 b is the innermost and smallest exoplanet discovered in the TOI-5624 system, located approximately 331 light-years from Earth in the constellation Ursa Major.

introduction.text: It is one of 5 planets known around TOI-5624. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
